entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Sweet, that door that was blockin'[n]our path's gone now.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: So this is what cognitive control looks like...
entries.uk: То ось який вигляд має[n]когнітивний контроль...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You're gonna have a heart attack if you[n]keep gettin' surprised like that.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Haha... Honestly though, this is all[n]somewhat hard to believe.
entries.uk: Ха-ха... Але, щиро кажучи, у все це[n]якось важко повірити.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Look, there is a counter up ahead.[n]Shall we head there first?
entries.uk: Погляньте, попереду стійка.[n]Може, спершу підемо туди?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I suppose there would be no issue[n]in stopping by. Let us go.
